retrievalProfile.description: A somber, monochromatic interior scene featuring a seated figure and a window looking out onto a contrasting stormy landscape, ideal for themes of isolation or internal reflection.
triggerTerms: man in suit sitting in floral armchair
excludeWhen: cheerful or high-energy themes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly detailed, desaturated surrealist painting of a man in a suit and dark glasses sitting in a floral-patterned armchair. He is positioned in a sparse room next to a window that reveals a dark, stormy city skyline with lightning. A small, colorful bird on the windowsill provides the only significant pop of color against a sea of grey tones.
coreVisualRelationships: The seated man is the primary focal point on the right, balanced by a dresser on the left.
The window serves as a central portal to a more dynamic, external world.
The black cat at the man's feet anchors the bottom-center of the composition.
The colorful bird acts as a visual foil to the otherwise grey-scale environment.
coreInvariants: Predominantly grey and desaturated color palette
High-contrast lighting from the window source
Detailed textures on the armchair and wall cracks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The man in the armchair occupies the right third of the frame at a medium-full scale; the window dominates the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The floral armchair provides a dense, patterned anchor for the human subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the man's face, moves left to the colorful bird, then up through the window to the lightning, and finally down to the cat.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat, textured grey walls create a sense of emptiness and claustrophobia.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone greys and charcoals define the environment and mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the cat, suit, and shadows provide structural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated greens and yellows on the bird create a singular point of interest.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation across 95% of the image, with high value contrast in the lightning and window frame.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky weights for the primary title
Tight kerning and uniform stroke width
Secondary text is thin, widely spaced, and uppercase

composition.relationshipToImage: floating in negative space above the window

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric display paired with an airy, wide-tracked secondary line for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy feel of the primary title.
Provides the necessary blocky presence and modern-retro feel.
Ideal for the wide-tracked, thin subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surrealist oil painting of a man in a suit and sunglasses sitting in a floral armchair in a grey room. Include a window showing a stormy city with lightning and a small colorful bird on the sill. Leave the top 15% of the image as empty grey wall space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold geometric sans-serif title in white at the top center. Directly below it, add a subtitle in a thin, light-grey sans-serif font with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the primary title centered and heavy?
Is the subtitle significantly smaller with wide tracking?
Is the color palette strictly grey except for the bird?
Does the man's armchair have a detailed floral pattern?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific band name or album title
Do not replicate the artist's signature in the bottom right

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the window details

postGenerationChecks: Check that the bird is the only vibrant element.
Ensure the man's glasses are opaque black.
Verify the storm is visible through the window panes.
Confirm the typography is perfectly centered and legible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Interior + Monochromatic Palette + Single Color Accent + Heavy Geometric Typography
